splits.train: global_splits.json:train; fit model and both normalizers only
splits.validation: global_splits.json:val; checkpoint selection and stopping only
splits.evaluation: global_splits.json:eval; locked until every arm and failure record freezes

rng_contract.pairing: same five seeds for every arm: initialization, minibatch order, rollout and bootstrap pairing
rng_contract.streams: derive independent train, rollout and bootstrap streams as SeedSequence(seed).spawn(3) in that order
rng_contract.determinism: torch float64 deterministic algorithms; no diagnostic rerun replaces a registered run

state_adapter.raw_coordinate: Segment.x[:,0] = parquet column x; column y is never read
state_adapter.normalization: m=(m_X,m_V), S=diag(s_X,s_V) from all adapted train timepoints; coordinatewise mean and population std (ddof=0); require finite s_X,s_V>=1e-8; z=S^-1(r-m); reuse unchanged on val/eval and every arm

model_coordinate_policy.I1: fit and exact-rollout only in raw r=[X_raw,V_raw]; never feed z into SegmentConstantSDE
model_coordinate_policy.neural: fit and Euler-Maruyama rollout in normalized z=[X_n,V_n]
model_coordinate_policy.evaluation: at every registered grid point transform I1 raw r to common z=S^-1(r-m) before metric, event, histogram or delta evaluation

environment_feature.start_map: manifest segment_start_map_path is UTF-8 JSONL with exactly fields segment_id,file_id,absolute_start_epoch; segment_id unique; every used segment has exactly one row; file_id must match trajectory; epoch is finite integer Unix seconds; hash must equal segment_start_map_sha256
environment_feature.condition_file_map: manifest condition_file_manifest_path is UTF-8 JSONL with exactly fields file_id,relative_path,sha256; file_id unique; every used file_id has exactly one row; resolve relative_path under cond_root and verify sha256; zero or duplicate candidate files fail; runtime glob selection is forbidden
environment_feature.source: the uniquely manifested condition parquet, column solar_elev only
environment_feature.alignment: convert condition t to integer Unix seconds; inclusive window [absolute_start_epoch, absolute_start_epoch + (segment.t[-1]-segment.t[0])] from the hashed start map
environment_feature.aggregation: require at least one aligned row and require every aligned solar_elev value finite, then arithmetic mean all aligned rows; day_fraction and every other column excluded; filtering nonfinite rows is forbidden
environment_feature.missing_policy: fail arm before fit on missing/duplicate mapping or file, hash mismatch, empty window, nonfinite aligned value, or nonfinite/near-constant train normalizer; no imputation
environment_feature.normalization: fit scalar mean and population std (ddof=0) over train segments only; fail if nonfinite or std<1e-8; reuse unchanged on val/eval and all neural arms

neural_diffusion_contract.bridge_correction: a @ grad(log_h) in state order [X,V]; component 0 acts on X and component 1 acts on V

neural_architecture.activation: torch.nn.Tanh after each hidden Linear; no output activation
neural_architecture.initialization: all Linear weights xavier_uniform_ with calculate_gain('tanh'); all Linear biases zero
neural_architecture.drift_clip: elementwise clamp network drift to [-10.0,10.0] before NLL and rollout

i1.stopping: relative train NLL improvement <1e-5, otherwise max_iter; no validation tuning

neural.objective: one-step Gaussian NLL on normalized [X,V]: mean=z+(dt/60)b_clipped(z,e), covariance=(dt/60)diag(exp(2ell_X),exp(2ell_V))
neural.stopping: validation NLL patience=30 completed epochs and absolute min_delta=1e-5
neural.checkpoint: minimum validation NLL; exact tie goes to earliest epoch

rollout.I1: fit and exact Gaussian rollout in raw r=[X_raw,V_raw] where dX_raw=V_raw dt; after each event-grid interval transform r to z=S^-1(r-m) for all evaluations; never propagate z through the raw kernel
rollout.neural: Euler-Maruyama in normalized [X,V], left endpoint coefficients, h=min(1.0 second, remaining interval), z_next=z+(h/60)b_clipped+sqrt(h/60)B epsilon, no adaptive stepping
rollout.time_grid: t_0=0; t_k=min(k*1.0 seconds,T), including t=0 and exact endpoint T

energy_half.failure: M<2 or any nonfinite state is metric failure

hdr90.density: 2D Gaussian KDE over M=1000 samples; sample covariance denominator M-1; Scott f=M^(-1/6); H=f^2*S+1e-9*I
hdr90.threshold: sort M leave-none-out KDE densities ascending; q=ceil(0.10*M)=100; threshold=sorted[q-1]
hdr90.membership: closed rule density_H(y)>=threshold; with unique forecast densities this contains 901/1000 and ties can only increase membership; fail if H or density nonfinite/non-positive
hdr90.report: finite-sample set has at least 90.1% forecast-sample mass, never described as exactly 90%; report eval-truth coverage and abs(coverage-0.90)

event.hit_rule: E true iff closed-set X(t_k) in A at any registered point including t=0,T; never read velocity
event.histogram_rule: terminal state[0]=X only; searchsorted(edges,X,side='right')-1; X=8 belongs [8,+inf)

bridge_dual.neural_correction: a_z @ grad_z(log_h) in normalized order state[0]=X then state[1]=V
bridge_dual.I1_raw_correction: with z=S^-1(r-m), grad_r(log_h)=S^-T grad_z(log_h); apply raw a_r S^-T grad_z(log_h), equivalently normalized correction S^-1 a_r S^-T grad_z(log_h)
bridge_dual.I1_event_transform: evaluate normalized A,D and bins only after z=S^-1(r-m); equivalently A_raw=m_X+s_X*A and D_raw=m_X+s_X*D with s_X>0, closed boundaries preserved
bridge_dual.exclusion: boolean complement not E per path
bridge_dual.reconstruction: normalized terminal-X raw full-support bin counts including underflow/overflow; sum_j abs(p_recon_j-p_prior_j)<=1e-12
bridge_dual.strata: hit and non-hit counts positive; else undefined_stratum and never pass
bridge_dual.fp_mc_l1: analytic-prior versus Monte-Carlo error separately without 1e-12 tolerance

delta_probe.displacement: DeltaX_i=state_i[T,0]-state_i[0,0] on normalized train trajectories; never read state[1]
delta_probe.failure: nonfinite/zero sigma_hist or empty erosion is failure/NA; never replace delta

metric_definitions.energy_half: mean per-cell Energy U-statistic; lower is better
metric_definitions.hdr90_abs_calibration_error: for each bootstrap arm compute abs(mean HDR membership over crossed cells - 0.90); lower is better

inference.bootstrap: B=2000; replicate b samples one length-5 seed index vector with replacement and one length-N_eval ordered segment index vector with replacement, then uses their Cartesian product with multiplicity; the same two vectors are shared by all 8 arms, both metrics and all 7 contrasts; seed and segment are crossed, never nested
inference.family_shared_draws: within replicate b every contrast in I1-capacity, neural-capacity and structure uses the same matrix-wide index vectors before max_c
inference.pointwise_ci: percentile [Q_0.025(theta_b),Q_0.975(theta_b)] over B=2000 using Hyndman-Fan type 7 / numpy method='linear': h=(B-1)p, interpolate between zero-based floor(h) and ceil(h)
inference.raw_p: approximate centered-bootstrap two-sided Monte-Carlo p=(1+#_b abs(theta_b-theta_hat)>=abs(theta_hat))/(B+1); not an exact permutation/randomization p-value
inference.holm: separate family per (metric_id,contrast family); family sizes exactly I1-capacity=3, neural-capacity=3, structure=1; sort raw p ascending with contrast_id lexical tie-break; adjusted rank r is cumulative max min(1,(m-r+1)*p_r)
inference.simultaneous_ci: within each (metric_id,contrast family), q=Q_0.95(max_c abs(theta_b,c-theta_hat_c)) using type-7 linear interpolation; interval theta_hat_c+[-q,+q]; family sizes 3,3,1
inference.complete_cube_policy: for a metric require every one of 8 arms x 5 seeds x N_eval segment_ids; if any cell is missing/failed/nonfinite, all 7 contrast rows for that metric are status=unavailable and every estimate/CI/p/Holm field literal NA; no complete-case deletion or imputation

arm_results.rule: one row per key; energy/HDR only on base; dual/event on all directions; delta_probe_value is forbidden and direction-specific dual/event columns are the probe values; NA literal NA

contrast_results.required_record_set: Cartesian product of all 7 predeclared contrast_id values and the 2 metric_enum values; no extra or missing rows
contrast_results.rule: exactly 14 rows per execution/data/split identity with fixed left/right/effect, pointwise/simultaneous CI and raw/Holm fields; unavailable propagation uses literal NA
